title: At The Edge - No. 2
description: "At The Edge No. 2" was painted early on for a series show I did in November, 2015. It was completed as seen here, but never used in the show.

title: Biloxi Shrimp Boats
description: The "Lucky Lou" and "Mimi" tied up in the back bay of Biloxi, Mississippi in a time before Hurricane Katrina. I don't know if they are there anymore. I hope so.

title: Emerald Edge
description: "Emerald Edge" is part of a series show I did in November of 2015, titled AT THE EDGE.

title: Fishing Boats At Moss Landing
description: I have a special admiration for anyone who earns their living by fishing the lakes and seas. It's a hard and sometimes dangerous job. The sights and sounds and activity of a fishing marina always catch my interest. For centuries, people have loved paintings of harbors with ships and boats and the people who work them.

title: Landscape
description: FAA Contest Winner - First Prize for " ABSTRACT LANDSCAPE"

title: Niagara Vineyards Fall
description: This is the third work in a commissioned series of seasonal views of Niagara Vineyards in Ontario. This third painting depicts the fall harvest of grapes under the deep blue sky of October on the "benchland" halfway between Lake Ontario and the top of the Niagara Escarpment. . Each of the four seasonal paintings by artist Bruce Repei are from views of Beamsville, Ontario

title: Niagara Vineyards Spring
description: This is the Spring version of a commissioned set of four paintings depicting different seasonal views of Niagara Vineyards in Ontario. All the fours scenes are in Beamsville, Ontario. This work features a plum tree in blossom in the forground.

title: Niagara Vineyards Summer
description: This is the Summer view of Niagara vineyards in Ontario, the second of four commissioned works by artist Bruce Repei. Each of the four seasonal scenes in the collection are views from Beamsville, Ontario. This scene is on the "benchland" which is half way up the Niagara Escarpment . The benches are favoured for growing some of the best grapes.

title: Niagara Vineyards Winter
description: This is the fourth painting in a commissioned series by artist Bruce Repei depicting four seasons of Niagara vineyards in Ontario. This winter view is on top of the Niagara Escarpment in Beamsville, Ontario. Lake Ontario can be seen far below on the horizon.

title: On The Gulf
description: This large painting conveys a feeling of wind, sea air and speed on the Gulf of Mexico just beyond Gulfport, Mississippi on the way to Ship Island.

title: Opening Night
description: This scene is an opening night at the entrance of the beautiful Princess of Wales Theatre. The show was the stage version of LORD OF THE RINGS. It premiered that night and later moved on to London, England. I have many good memories of shows I worked on at this theatre including Disney's THE LION KING.

title: Ship Island Palmetto
description: Ship Island is a protected National Seashore just off the coast of Mississippi in the Gulf of Mexico. It is rich in natural beauty as well as history. Just beyond this path is one of the most beautiful beaches in the country.

title: St. Marks
description: This was a scene which happened long ago on my way home from grade school. It was a cold December night after a snowfall. My route home took me through this churchyard. I stopped to take in the still beauty in the midst of the city and I could hear the organ and choir inside practicing their Christmas music. That was just over fifty years ago and I still remember that moment whenever I walk past St. Mark's.

title: Stockbridge
description: This large painting by Bruce Repei depicts a beautiful old pediment on a colonial home in Stockbridge, Massachusetts - Norman Rockwell country. This detailed painting tells of skilled workmanship and carpentry that has aged gracefully through many years on a fine old home. It is also home to the sparrows who have built their nest in the shelter of this pediment over the front door of the house.

title: The Edge In A Dream
description: "The Edge in a Dream" was painted early in the process for a series show I did in November, 2015. It was never included in the show.

title: The First Light
description: This small painting was done with generously applied oils on canvas adhered to a wood panel. It was done in one session. I later did a much larger version of the same image on a stretched canvas approximately 4ft. X 6ft.

title: The Music Box
description: The Music Box Theater in New York has personal significance for me. The use of green is taken from the interior of the theater. Dark green like the forest or British racing green is the colour I love the most. This oil painting on canvas was composed from offcut pieces of collage fashioned into the shapes and people in the picture.
